parsed.rationale: The pipeline's `default-impl-candidates` signal identifies three conformers — `MaterialBlendMode`, `PlaybackBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — each implementing `.blendMode` at exactly line 62 of their respective files in the same `Wallpaper` package under `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/`. The identical line number across all three files is strong structural evidence that the bodies are the same and can be collapsed into a single protocol extension default. Although `_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift` carries a codegen prefix, the other two files do not, so the all-codegen restraint rule does not apply; the mixed nature of the cluster makes consolidation into a hand-authored default extension the correct action. Placing the default implementation in a new `BlendMode+Defaults.swift` within the same `Wallpaper` package keeps the change entirely within the existing package boundary and avoids any cross-package coupling.
